title: Cheap Car Challenge Prep is OVER! Mustang Barely Starts in Time

context.edition: CRC 2 per caller labelling = Sick Summer leg of the $7,500/$10,000 challenge; final prep + day 0 tech

rules.fact: Rule mentioned: car should be sellable for the max budget ($10,000)

Day 0 ruling: budgets 'out the window' - nobody except Lumberjack made budget; no improvements allowed from this point (run what you brung); small fixes like converter swap allowed, no major upgrades or nitrous jet changes
Jackstand put on probation and locked out of further changes after going over budget

event.name: Sick Summer (live on Freedom Plus Mon-Fri)

people.name: 'London' (= Lund Racing, per later video mls_oZ9EQQg)

cars.owner_driver: Jackstand (James); backup driver Leo from R3

engine.notes: old engine sold - buyer paid the remaining $1,800 on camera (total $3,300)

power_adder.nitrous_shot: 'two and a quarter' jet = ~225 hp shot (lightest, as used all race week)

fuel.carburetor: TRC custom carb tuned by Carburetor Craig
fuel.plug_heat_range: 10 (said slightly cold; ~9 or 8 typical for 200 hp of nitrous)

intake.air_cleaner: $18 air cleaner bought at Innovative Racecraft, traded for a used scoop

dyno.type: chassis dyno (car strapped down, run through gears) - wheel vs crank not stated
dyno.notes: flat power from 6,000 up; throttle stuck once, front seal leak

dyno.rpm_range: short pull, ended ~6,500 rpm while still climbing
dyno.notes: ~250 hp gain; leaking nitrous solenoid replaced before pull

weight_lb.notes: uncut doors, power windows, all glass, all-steel body

parts.part: Interior, handbrake, stock front brakes SOLD (credit)
Motion Raceworks valve covers (paid $100; retail $540 without fittings)
IDS front coilovers (invoice $300) - DISALLOWED, not installed

budget.ruling: over budget once valve covers valued at retail; on probation, no further improvements; race brakes already fitted

cars.confidence: high for dyno/weight, medium for budget

base_vehicle.model: El Camino (doors joked as made of tank steel)

engine.notes: spare motor carried along strapped in the back

transmission.notes: valve body added; seals and one clutch pack replaced with factory parts; input shaft

fuel.pump: Aeromotive 5.0 pump brought but not installed; agreed value $700 if used

parts.part: Motion Raceworks catch can (safety, not counted)

engine.family: Ford Coyote Gen 2 (stock block, Gen 2 rods)
engine.rotating_assembly: rebuilt at Fast Forward (Joe) with mixed/unknown rods (I- or H-beam) and 'Diamond' pistons (claimed no-name brand); piston-to-wall clearance on the big side
engine.notes: old oil pan (tapped, JB-Welded) swapped; oil filter housing leak from Gen 1 housing on Gen 2 block

transmission.type: automatic with lockup + trans-brake (model not stated)
transmission.notes: teardown showed missing thrust washers/heat marks - design limited around 800 hp, fine for ~400 hp stock; billet parts suggested; spare lockup trans as equal replacement; Zach rebuilt it 3 times

rear_end.notes: differential welded by Tye after spinning one tire, losing the shootout and bending rods

race_setting.notes: returned to old boost-controller settings for the strip; trans-brake verified holding

engine.family: Chevy big block (swapped from small block)
engine.notes: traded small block for big block + $500 merch (counted $250)

cars.ignition: Holley smart coils (part of $2,500 Holley package, counted $1,250 as sponsored)

converter.notes: converter too tight; considering bypass or spraying on the trans-brake
